title: Tamil Nadu Politics – Morning Brief – 1 November 2026
headline: Opposition slams TVK govt for repeated prison escapes across Tamil Nadu

sections.big_picture:
Overnight developments across Tamil Nadu centered on sharp opposition condemnation of the state government following a series of custodial escapes from central prisons in Theni and Coimbatore. Political parties including AIADMK, DMK, and PMK united in demanding an independent security audit and accountability from the Home Department, raising serious concerns regarding facility oversight and administrative surveillance.

Simultaneously, preparations commenced statewide for Tamil Nadu Day observances, spotlighting deep ideological divergences between national commemorations on November 1 and Dravidian identity observances tied to July 18. With student welfare protests and educational debates surrounding NEET and government school amenities continuing across northern districts, the political atmosphere remains charged across both administrative and legislative spheres.

top_developments.headline: T.N. govt. raises DA for its employees from 60% to 63%
top_developments.summary: Chennai Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay on Saturday announced a hike in dearness allowance (DA) for government employees and teachers with effect from July 2026. A State government press release said the DA for employees had been increased from 60% to 63%, following a similar increase for Central government employees from July 2026. The revised DA would apply to the Tamil Nadu government employees and teachers with effect from the same date.

sources.title: ‘Administrative incompetence’ characterises TVK’s reign in the State, says Palaniswami
sources.snippet: CHENNAI AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami on Saturday criticised the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam-led government for its “administrative incompetence”. Addressing a meeting in Maraimalai Nagar on the outskirts of Chennai amid the 55th formation day celebrations of his party, Mr. Palaniswami wondered what had been the achievement of the TVK-led government. Even schemes launched by it, such as the marriage assistance scheme for women, were originally implemented by the previous AIADMK regime, which had provided the financial assistance along with gold for thirumangalyam.

top_developments.headline: Take action against officials who arrested MIDS professor, Stalin urges T.N. government
top_developments.summary: Stalin on Saturday demanded action against police officials who had exceeded their remit by arresting Madras Institute of Development Studies (MIDS) professor Kalaiarasan. He also demanded action against the virtual miscreants whose activity had led to the arrest. Kalaiarasan was arrested over a comment on a fake ID. He raised his voice against the injustice meted out to him and came out. I appreciate him,” he said in a social media post.

sections.government_and_administration:
- **"Students' exams postponed for Principal's visit to Pudukottai?" – Velmurugan:** Tamil Nadu Life Rights Party President Velmurugan said, "Should the exams of Pudukottai Government Women's Arts College students be postponed for the Chief Minister's visit to Pudukottai? Is the Chief Minister's visit more important than the future of the students?" He has questioned. In a statement released by Velmurugan, "The news that the examinations to be held at Pudukottai Government College of Arts for Women have been postponed due to Chief Minister Joseph Vijay's visit to Pudukottai is shocking. As the Chief Minister is coming to inaugurate the renovated Pudukottai Bus Stand, the examinations of the students... ([News18 Tamil Nadu](https://tamil.news18.com/tamil-nadu/student-exam-postponed-for-chief-minister-visit-velmurugan-question-nw-azt-ws-bl-2243349.html))
- **Sollathigaram welfare scheme? Do not stick stickers. I say this just happens?:** Sollathigaram — welfare scheme? Do not stick stickers. I say this is what will happen? DMK Raja Tamilamaran challenge.. ([News18 Tamil Nadu](https://tamil.news18.com/videos/tamil-nadu/sollathigaram-2243490.html))
- **“Criminals in prison live freely under the regime of Thaveka” – Nayanar Nagendran:** Tamil Nadu BJP leader Nayanar Nagendran has criticized the incident of escape of prisoners by saying, "Since Thaveka came to power, the criminals who are walking outside are roaming boldly, while the criminals in the jail are living freely." Regarding this, Tamil Nadu BJP leader Nayanar Nagendran said on his X page, "The news that the undertrial arrested in the robbery case in Annoor, Coimbatore has escaped for the second time after Chennai and Theni is shocking. The government continues to protect the public without properly monitoring the convict who escaped the first time... ([News18 Tamil Nadu](https://tamil.news18.com/tamil-nadu/nainar-nagendran-criticizes-prison-inmate-escape-nw-azt-ws-bl-2243456.html))
- **AMMK leader targets Tamil Nadu govt over power cuts, questions energy minister’s continuance:** AMMK chief TTV Dhinakaran accuses Tamil Nadu govt of administrative failures causing unscheduled power cuts, targets TNPDCL and questions energy minister. ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/ammk-leader-targets-tamil-nadu-govt-over-power-cuts-questions-energy-ministers-continuance/articleshow/135410626.cms))
- **Higher Education Department wants HoDs to prepare students for placement; activists cry foul:** Chennai The Tamil Nadu Higher Education Department has decided to task Heads of Departments (HoDs) of higher education institutions with the primary responsibility of preparing students for employment. Education activists, in response, have demanded a roll back stating that HoDs, who are subject experts, cannot be expected to perform the duties of placement officers. The Department’s decision was communicated to the Commissioner of Collegiate Education, Director of Technical Education, and Registrars of all universities through a letter on Friday. ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/higher-education-department-wants-hods-to-prepare-students-for-placement-activists-cry-foul/article71649062.ece))

- **"They are releasing videos as if big problems are happening in Tamil Nadu" - Minister Aadhav Arjuna:** A review meeting was held at the Periyar Community Welfare Center in Thirumangalam, Chennai, on the Monsoon Precautionary Work for Villivakkam Assembly Constituency. The meeting was chaired by Minister Aadhav Arjuna and was attended by Chennai City Commissioner Samaran and Chennai District Collector Malathi Halan. Minister Aadhav Arjuna who met the media after the review meeting said; "I am doing my job as a member of the legislature. People know what the members of the legislature have done for five years. Even in the meeting held 15 days ago, everyone including the mayor was invited... - **Plea in Madras high court against extension of special officers tenure for rural local bodies:** Plea in Madras HC challenges Tamil Nadu’s extension of special officers for rural local bodies, seeking ward delimitation completion and elections across 37 districts. ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/plea-in-madras-high-court-against-extension-of-special-officers-tenure-for-rural-local-bodies/articleshow/135410326.cms))
- **Madras High Court Advocates Association challenges 1965 Union Cabinet decision to continue English as common language for Supreme Court and all High Courts:** CHENNAI The Madras High Court Advocates Association (MHAA) has filed a public interest litigation petition in the High Court challenging the constitutional validity of an Union Cabinet Committee’s 1965 decision that English should continue as the common language for the Supreme Court and all High Courts in the country until it could be replaced with Hindi. First Division Bench of Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan would be hearing the case on Monday (November 2, 2026). ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/madras-high-court-advocates-association-challenges-1965-union-cabinet-decision-to-continue-english-as-common-language-for-supreme-court-and-all-high-courts/article71648537.ece))
- **A petition has been filed seeking an order to speed up the local body elections in Tamil Nadu:** In Tamil Nadu, a case has been filed in the Madras High Court seeking an order to complete the ward redelineation work within the specified period and conduct elections in rural local bodies in 37 districts. The tenure of elected representatives of village panchayats, panchayat unions and district panchayats in 28 districts of Tamil Nadu ended on 5th January 2025. The Tamil Nadu government ordered the appointment of officers from the rural development and panchayat departments as special officers to manage these rural local bodies. ([News18 Tamil Nadu](https://tamil.news18.com/tamil-nadu/petition-in-madras-high-court-urging-swift-local-body-elections-vjr-ws-l-2243498.html))
sections.district_developments:
- **Man escapes from police custody before being lodged in Coimbatore Central Prison:** COIMBATORE A 25-year-old man, Raghavan, who was convicted of theft in Bengaluru a few months ago, escaped from police custody for the second time in Coimbatore in the early hours of Saturday (October 31, 2026). He had first escaped from custody on June 19, 2026, while being transported from Coimbatore to Bengaluru. Following the incident, the Annur police registered a case against him. He was arrested in Bhavani on Friday (October 30) in connection with the case. ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/convict-escapes-from-police-custody-before-being-lodged-in-coimbatore-central-prison/article71648346.ece))
- **Tamil Nadu shuts prison enterprises outside campuses, recalls around 400 warders to plugs security gaps:** Tamil Nadu shuts prison enterprises outside campuses after Theni jailbreak, recalling 300–400 warders to boost prison security; inside-campus industries continue.
